Chapter 976 Chapter 30: Lin Yuan Patrols The Heavens, Dominates The Universe (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 976  Chapter 30: Lin Yuan Patrols the Heavens, Dominates the Universe (Please Subscribe)

Outside the wooden hut.

Two ultimate true bodies of the Robber Clan stepped out, showing unprecedented attention to the Galaxy Master.

Normally, at least one of the two ultimate beings from the Robber Clan should remain inside the wooden hut, but now, with Lin Yuan's arrival, both ultimates appeared.

"This wooden hut must be what you've depended on to survive through the cosmic catastrophes, correct?" Lin Yuan said with a smile, while also closely examining the hut.

The wooden hut looked utterly ordinary, hardly noticeable, yet every detail of its structure contained infinite power, with Chaos Qi pervading within.

"That's right, this wooden hut is the ultimate foundation of our Robber Clan. Our ancestors originally constructed this kind of hut to preserve our lineage and embedded it within the universe, leaving behind a branch within it," the Robber Clan ultimate being on the left said candidly.

In their hearts, they viewed Lin Yuan as the reincarnation of a supreme Great Saint who, upon stepping into the Twelfth Layer, would inevitably awaken part of his memories. Even if they didn't speak, he could deduce as much.

"Indeed, it's prudent," Lin Yuan nodded in response.

Where is the safest place in the Chaos Void?

The Chaos Continent?

A secret abode?

Or the dwelling of a Chaos Great Saint?

No.

None of the above.

Even the dwellings and domains left by the supreme Great Saints among the Chaos Great Saints cannot exist forever. They will ultimately collapse one day.

If not collapsing on their own, then they will be destroyed by external forces, or occupied by another Great Saint of the same level.

But the universe?

The Chaos Void gives birth to countless universes, each connected to the Chaos Void Origin.

The universe can be affected by external forces, such as attacks from beings of the Great Saint level, which are sufficient to hasten the universe towards a catastrophic end.

However, this so-called great destruction is merely a method of cosmic cycle; following destruction comes rebirth, and the universe itself remains.

Even a supreme Great Saint cannot erase a universe from its roots. Doing so would be akin to contending with the Chaos Void itself. Even for beings of the Thirteenth Layer, the Perfect Time Beings, it would require a devastating sacrifice, and they would forever lose the chance to become Perfect Time Beings.

And the universe itself is forbidden to external life forms. This rule makes the universe's intrinsic combat power limit not high, making it extremely safe compared to the Chaos Void.

Originally, Xuanhuang created 33,333 Xuanhuang Secret Realms scattered without pattern across various universes, ensuring that his lineage would almost certainly never be extinguished.

Even if a Xuanhuang Secret Realm within a universe encountered an accident, would all 33,333 secret realms across the universes face accidents?

The likelihood does exist, but it's horrifyingly low.

These 33,333 Xuanhuang Secret Realms, not even Xuanhuang himself knows their exact locations. If a supreme Great Saint of the same level wanted to cut off Xuanhuang's lineage,

Could they possibly search every single universe one by one?

The Chaos Void nurtures countless universes, akin to the relationship between the ocean and a single drop of seawater. Even a supreme Great Saint could not traverse every corner of the Chaos Void.

And the Robber Clan has always hidden within the universe, and although their upper limit is fixed at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, at least they do not face the danger of extinction.

And according to what the ultimate being of the Robber Clan said, the current Robber Clan belongs to a branch of a powerful force in the Chaos Void, specially created to prevent the interruption of the force's legacy.

"Which force do your ancestors hail from?" Lin Yuan asked curiously.

To deploy methods within universes, one has to be at least at the level of a Chaos Great Saint. Could it be like the Xuanhuang Secret Realms created by Xuanhuang?

"I do not know," the Robber Clan ultimate being on the right shook his head and said, "Deep within our bloodlines there are seals, all memories regarding our ancestors are sealed. Only when we leave the universe and reside in the Chaos Void will the seals be lifted."

"I see," Lin Yuan nodded.

According to the information left by the lineage of Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master, this is a common arrangement made by forces at the Great Saint level.

"If within this Cosmic Era, our Robber Clan gives birth to a new Twelfth Layer, at the time of cosmic collapse, we could take some of our people out of the universe and into the Chaos Void. Those within the universe would be left in the hands of the newly born Twelfth Layer," explained the Robber Clan ultimate being on the left.

Similar arrangements have been made by their ancestors in many universes.

"Galaxy Master, if you are willing, during this Cosmic Era we could take some humans to survive through the next Cosmic Era, but of course, in the next Cosmic Era, we would encounter the aversion of the cosmic consciousness," said the Robber Clan ultimate being on the right.

If Lin Yuan truly was the reincarnation of a Great Saint, then even without relying on the Robber Clan, he could ensure the survival of human civilization through numerous Cosmic Eras.

The reason the Robber Clan ultimate expressed this offer was entirely to ingratiate themselves with Lin Yuan.

"We'll see when the time comes," Lin Yuan said casually.

Now it is far too early to think about the next Cosmic Era, and besides, Lin Yuan himself possesses means to endure until then, such as the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm coexists with the universe, its sophistication surpassing even that of the Robber Clan's wooden hut.

Of course, whether it's the hut or the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, any being that survives to the next Cosmic Era will be targeted by the cosmic consciousness itself.

"Alright."

"When the time comes, Galaxy Master, if you need anything, just tell us," the two Robber Clan ultimates said to each other, offering immediately.

...

At the edge of the universe in a certain expanse of starry space.

The figures of dozens of Twelfth Layer ultimates descended.

"The will of the Xuanyuan Supreme from human civilization is that if they want peace, they must surrender ninety percent of their Twelfth Layer weapons, treasures, and rare items, and afterward, live within the region delineated by human civilization..." The ultimate being from the Zhou Clan said with an ugly expression, conveying the decision of human civilization.

"Surrender ninety percent of Twelfth Layer weapons, treasures, and rare items? Human civilization is asking for too much, aren't they?"

"Does the Galaxy Master really think he can have us completely at his mercy? Indeed, we are no match for the Galaxy Master at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, but if we hide within our Clan Suppression Weapon, can the Galaxy Master really do anything to us?"

"That's right, hiding in the Clan Suppression Weapon, what can the peak of the Path Splitting Realm do?"

One after another, the twelve-tier ultimate beings were extremely indignant. Taking refuge in the Clan Suppression Weapon for a desperate survival was an act of last resort, and if possible, they still hoped to live under the starry sky.

That was what was best for their respective tribes as well.

Although the Clan Suppression Weapon contained vast spaces, those were merely spaces; compared to a universe that could breed countless lives, it was far from enough.

For a tribe, if they reproduced within the space of a weapon for a long time, the potential and talents of the tribespeople would plummet drastically, with barely any chance to ascend to the twelfth tier.

But to surrender ninety percent of twelfth-tier weapons, treasures, and exotic items? This demand was too excessive.

Some cold-natured twelve-tier ultimate beings would never agree to this demand.

Not every twelve-tier ultimate being cared for their tribe's future generations; many of them only cared about themselves.

To surrender ninety percent of twelfth-tier weapons and treasures? It would severely affect them personally, and when the universe was on the brink of destruction, facing endless ruin, having lost their main weapons, even their chances of survival would drop considerably.

And even if they were lucky enough to make it to the Chaos Void, facing dangers from all sides, how would they resist?

"I disagree."

"I also disagree."

One by one, the twelve-tier ultimate beings expressed their stance. They would rather watch their tribes be annihilated than hand over their weapons and treasures.

Seeing this, the remaining twelve-tier ultimate beings also subdued their desire for peace.

They greatly valued their tribal descendants, but the demands of human civilization were too much. Without doing anything, they were expected to hand over all their foundations?

"In that case, let us test our strength against human civilization, against the Galaxy Master."

An ultimate being of the Zhou Tribe spoke out, "Next, I suggest that all the major tribes gather together and combine all our forces to resist the Galaxy Master."

"Good."

"Let's do that."

"Bring all the twelfth-tier weapons from your tribes, activate the Clan Suppression Weapons and foundation weapons, and let that Galaxy Master see that we are not to be trifled with."

The numerous twelve-tier ultimate beings said.

They did not seek to contend with the Galaxy Master, but as long as they could barely withstand the Galaxy Master's attacks, they would have the capital to negotiate with human civilization.

...

The territory of human civilization.

The Number Three Stronghold, within the grand palace.

The ten most powerful beings of human civilization were casually conversing.

"The essence of space and time... essentially originates from the same source..." Lin Yuan spoke calmly.

Although he was communicating with the nine most powerful beings of human civilization, it was essentially an act of imparting wisdom.

Lin Yuan's comprehension of the rules was too profound, with hardly any among the Dao Realm being his match.

"Space and time..." The Great Saint Xia Qin and others had an epiphany. They had been stuck at the sixth realm of space and time for a long time. At this moment, listening to a seventh realm powerhouse's guidance had a significant impact on them.

"Hm?"

At this point, the Xuanyuan Supreme's expression subtly changed, and looking towards Lin Yuan, he said: "Galaxy Master, we've received a reply from the alien races."

"What did they say?"

"Did those twelfth-tier aliens agree?"

The other eight supremes immediately showed interest. At this time, human civilization held absolute dominance, making all supremes feel extremely pleased.

Since the Starry Sea Era, when had human civilization ever had such an uplifting moment in the endless battles with the peak tribes?

"They refused."

The Xuanyuan Supreme shook his head. He wasn't surprised by this reply.

Honestly, if he were in the position of the aliens, he wouldn't readily surrender nine-tenths of the twelfth-tier weapons and treasures either.

"Refused?"

"Then we shall make them agree."

"Galaxy Master, you tell us when we should take action."

The Great Saint Xia Qin and the others immediately spoke up, looking towards Lin Yuan.

"I will take action myself."

Lin Yuan smiled slightly, then stood up and took a step forward.

The universe roared, myriad rules converged, forming a majestic heavenly pathway that pierced through everything, traversing numerous star domains and connecting to a distant spot at the edge of the universe.

This heavenly pathway, wrought of countless rules, was dazzlingly brilliant. Originating from the east, it surged through the vast universe and reached the starry sky where dozens of twelve-tier ultimate beings resided.

"What is that? I can sense so many rules. A path built by infinite rules?"

"Who could this be? Even twelfth-tier ultimate beings couldn't gather so many rules!"

"The Galaxy Master... the other end of the pathway leads to the territory of human civilization; he must be taking action."

Across the universe, countless powerful beings were shocked. They quickly realized the source of this pathway - who but the Galaxy Master could accomplish this feat amongst the twelfth-tier ultimate beings of the universe?

"The other end of the path is the edge of the universe, the location where all the major peak tribes have retreated their forces?"

A heavenly pathway paved with infinite rules was undisguised, representing absolute power and dominance.

All the strong beings glimpsed a towering figure flashing past on the heavenly pathway, arriving at its distant end, before that remote space.

"Galaxy Master..."

Every being in the universe, even the lowest first or second-layer beings, felt the vast presence of the Galaxy Master.

A sea of vital energy flooded most of the universe, overseeing the starry sky, with myriad tribes bowing down.
